candidates.title: CyanBridge v2.4.5
candidates.summary: CyanBridge 2.4.5 fixes pairing for Mentra display glasses, adds display-glasses controls to the dashboard, and makes Meizu MYVU connections more robust. Recommended installation: Google Play For most users, the recommended way to install and update CyanBridge is through Google Play: Download CyanBridge from Google Play Google Play provides the simplest update path, automatic updates, and Play Protect checks. Availability of version 2.4.5 may follow the configured Play rollout. The APKs attached below are for users who specifically need direct sideloading. The AAB is for Play Console and testing tracks and cannot be installed directly. Changes Mentra display glasses pair again (Even Realities G1/G2, Mentra Display, NIMO, AR99): pairing from Device Bind no longer fails with "pairing failed: NOT_FOUND" right after the scan starts. Display-glasses controls on the dashboard: "Show test text", "Clear display" and "Forward notifications". Phone notifications now reach display glasses without
